sloka: दृष्ट्वा तमुपसङ्गम्य पौलस्त्यो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।कच्चिदार्य शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः प्राणा न ध्वंसितास्तव ।। ६.७४.१५ ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tamupasaṅgamya paulastyo vākyamabravīt।kaccidārya śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ prāṇā na dhvaṁsitāstava ।। 6.74.15 ।।

translations.english: "O Noble Jambavan! Indeed, your life has not been afflicted with these sharp arrows." Hearing this, Jambavan uttered these words with difficulty."
